comments.value: Yes please!!!! I would love to have VRCLens and some spotlights as their own locally spawnable objects. I don't want my avatar to be any worse than a poor rating. A prop system is needed for sure!

details:
With SDK3, it is now possible to add various useful functions to avatars. However, when using many avatars, it is necessary to configure each avatar individually. Therefore, I would like to see a function for extended items that can be commonly used by various avatars.
For example, it will be possible for users to set items that they always carry around to follow one of Humanoid's bones, or to freely create extensions that make VRChat even more comfortable to play with, such as camera extensions!
SDK3によってアバターに様々な便利機能を追加できるようになりました。ですがそれは、アバターを沢山利用する場合にアバター１つ１つにその設定をする必要があります。ですので、アバターとは別に色んなアバターで共通に使える拡張アイテム機能がほしいです。
例えば自分がつねに持ち歩くアイテムをHumanoidのいずれかのボーンに追従するような設定にしたり、カメラの拡張のようなVRChatを更に快適に遊べる拡張機能をユーザー側で自由に作ることが可能になると思います！
title: User extension item functionality separate from avatars/アバターとは別のユーザー拡張アイテム機能
